title: Linking Your Wallets Account To Your Paystack Account
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce that going forward, you can link your Wallets account to your[Paystack](https://paystack.com/) account and receive settlements on the go.


We’ve been getting feedback from customers like Danjo who wanted to be able to receive payouts to their business account and we knew we had to get to work on that.


###


@paystack doesn't take a https://t.co/3quyVDKUor corporate account for payout. I was thinking you guys should be friends right? As per banking the unbanked and making our lives easier. 😒😒😒😒😒😒😒


What this basically means for you is that the NUBAN number linked to your Wallets account is going to be able to receive payments from your Paystack account. Easy peasy uh?


[Now you can link your Wallet Business account to your Paystack account and receive settlements on the go. We're committed to making it easier for you to transact, and we've got you!](https://www.instagram.com/p/CFcb8ESnkbv/)


**Here’s a quick step by step guide on how that’s supposed to work.**


1. First, log in to your Paystack dashboard


2. Go to *Settings* and go to *Payout Accounts*


3. Add your Wallets Africa NUBAN number


And then that’s it. It’ll take some time for the team to verify, but after that, your Wallets account is connected to your Paystack account. Once you receive payments, you have it settled to your business account.
